One of the second-generation Grimms models developed as successors to the Goddess Squad.
Due to her long name, people around her usually call her "Siren".
Her whereabouts have been unknown since the First Rapture Invasion.

lines.text: What should I create with my bubbles today...
I should keep talking, or else I might forget how to speak.
Ah uh ah... Oh right, I can speak normally.
Now I can recreate my old friends perfectly, hehe.
I will treasure the strength that Abe gave me and use it for good.
Let's make sure to reach the end of this story together.
... As I expected, it's lonely with no one else around.

It's okay, I can wait.
I'm sure we'll see each other again, anyway.
This is a nice place. If we had all lived together in a place like this, I wonder what it would have been like?
I think this building would look lovely decorated with water droplets.
This place is so full of life. I hope everyone here will live a full and happy life.
I will never fall, never falter, for I must keep the promise I made to everyone.
I can make even more bubbles now.
Now, I'll be able to protect everyone.
If Abe could see me now, I'm sure she'd lavish me with praise, hehe.
This is perfect! Just what I needed.
Hansel and Gretel would have loved this even more than me.
I'll set this to the side, and show it off the next time I see everyone, hehe.
It feels so soft and squishy, just like bubbles.
I can feel my loneliness being replaced with happiness.
This warm feeling... it's the same as being inside a bubble.
Let's go and find everyone.
Did you call me?
The bubbles will show us the way.
I will turn everything into bubbles.
My voice is ready.
Let's go, everyone.
I'm not alone. We're all in this together.
Let me clear my throat...
Regroup, and let's go again.
I'll do my best. Cheer me on.
Bubbles!
Tell me the story of victory.
Go forth!
Good job.
Let's keep going, just a little bit more!
Yes, good.
Ugh!
That hurt...
This won't do... but we mustn't give up. We must try again.
The story will be rewritten into a tale that's happy and beautiful.
Look at the ocean. It's breathtaking.
Mori picked out this swimsuit for me. What do you think?
The sound of the waves... it's so invigorating...
Could we talk just a little longer, Prince?
P-Prince, what are you staring at? Ahh, I'm so embarrassed...
I'm glad we came to the beach. I hope we can stay here together like this, hehe.
It's okay... I'm used to being alone.
Take your time, Prince. I'll just spend some time playing with Tia and Naga.
I heard there's something called a swimming pool around here. Can I go take a look too?
It's a shame Tia and Naga's school doesn't have a campus here.
There are so many interesting things here. I wish Hansel and Gretel could have come too.
It's my first time wearing a swimsuit, so I'm a little self-conscious... But I'm happy, as long as you like it, Prince. Hehe.
My bubbles have become stronger!
I feel I can control any whirlpool that comes my way.
I can feel the power welling up inside me.
It's a lovely gift, but I'm even more touched by the thought you put into it.
Wow... I'm not sure I deserve something this nice... but since it's from you, I'll treasure it.
Is this for me? It's so pretty! I'll keep it safe in my bubbles forever.
M-my face is not red from embarrassment. It's just really hot out. Ah woo.
So soft and sweet... I feel like I've been wrapped up in one of my bubbles.
I don't feel lonely anymore with you by my side, Prince.
I'm ready.
I'm listening.
Ah woo... It's so hot out.
Let's quickly wrap this up and go play in the water.
Hehe. Shall we?
I'm ready. Let's go.
We can do this, because we're together.
It's so round.
Let's keep going.
I'll show you waves churning up bubbles.
Bubbles, at the ready.
Let's go play in the water, Prince. Ah woo...
Push through!
Good.
It's not over yet.
That did it.
Ouch!
That hurts...
Don't give up... Come on... Let's try again.
Since we won, why don't we go play a little longer? Hehe.
I feel like I have become one with the bubbles.
I hope that one day, I can show this place to everyone. My own space.
Someday, will I be able to swim freely outside these bubbles?
If Cinderella saw me like this, she would say I look beautiful, right?
La la la~ La la la la~♬

It's so warm in here.
It feels like everyone is embracing me.
I got all dressed up, but there's no one here to show off to...

If I wear a dress like this and wait,
it feels like a prince is going to come looking for me. Hehe.
When I'm here, I don't feel so lonely anymore.
Will I be able to become friends with everyone here someday?
Everyone here looks so happy and free. It's incredibly admirable.

I feel like a fish that is free to swim wherever it pleases.
Would you like to come with me?
The bubbles have become stronger.
It feels like I'm overflowing with energy.
So much time has passed. I'm sure everyone's grown stronger in the meantime, so I can't fall behind!
Wow, this would go perfectly with my current outfit!
I'll keep it safe and sound inside the bubbles. Hehe.
Can I share it with the fish too?
I adore it so much!
It feels so soft, warm and comforting—just like bubbles.
Like sunlight that brightens the deep, dark recesses of the sea.
Shall I swim over there?
